walkthroughReviewer: Fable review seat (agent), a different agent from the author
frontend: Vite preview reader at port 43312 serving the working canonical Markdown, proxied to the conversations lab at port 43302; both reader roles signed in
keyboard: Keyboard only: Tab from page load through the Help index to the guide link and Enter; Tab to an outline section link and Enter; Tab to the documentation search box, type the exact title and Enter, Tab to the result and Enter; Tab to the full documentation link and Enter. The focused element and its computed focus ring were read after every stop.
zoomMechanism: 200% zoom was emulated as a 640×450 CSS-pixel viewport at devicePixelRatio 2, which is the layout Chromium produces for a 1280×900 window at its 200% browser zoom setting. Playwright exposes no browser zoom menu, so the browser's own zoom control was not operated; text sizes are the computed CSS pixel sizes at that layout.
limitations: Emulated zoom as described above; not the browser zoom menu and not assistive technology acceptance.
Keyboard checks cover the Help index, article outline, search and the full documentation link; the application pages themselves were not walked by keyboard.
The 14px paragraph size at the zoomed layout is the reader's base size; readability is recorded as the computed size and the absence of overflow, not a human judgement.
